ruleDefinitions.name: LSA PPL Protection Disabled Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of the "reg.exe" utility to disable PPL protection on the LSA process

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\Lsa.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ add\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/d\\ 0.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/v\\ RunAsPPL\\ .*"))))
